back: The bank at the head of the banking system: issues currency, banker to government and banks, controls money and credit, supervises banks.

front: Functions of the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe
back: Issue notes and coins; banker to government; banker to banks; lender of last resort; monetary policy; supervise banks; manage foreign reserves.
The central bank lends to banks short of cash when no one else will, preventing failures and panic.
Central bank action on money, credit and interest rates to keep prices stable and support growth.
Policy (bank) rate, reserve requirements, open market operations, directives and moral suasion.
Higher rate → dearer loans → less borrowing and spending → slower price rises.
Central: stability, serves government and banks, issues currency, supervises. Commercial: profit, serves public, supervised.
Foreign currency, gold and other assets held by the central bank to pay for imports and debts and support the currency.
